text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Royce-san's Trainer, do you have a moment?

While taking a break,
I was called out to by Ikuno Dictus, Nice Nature,
and Matikanetannhauser.
choice_data_list: Yeah, sure... Did you want to talk about something?
Yeah, sure, but... did you want to talk about something?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Royce, having won multiple GⅠ races this year,
you've achieved a truly magnificent record.
And so—
A few days later. At a karaoke parlor near Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Royce, congrats—!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Royce-san, your performance this year has been truly magnificent. To honor your great achievements, here is a small token of celebration.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Totally, hats off to her~.
She swept the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Autumn), and the Japan Cup completely.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And then there's the Takarazuka Kinen, too!
I'm not just some 'valiant runner-up' anymore—I'm a regular gold collector~!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"O peerless musician!
Let us now sing praises to your magnificent melody."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Turbo might even acknowledge you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank... tha...
Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaâ¡ Royce, I'm so happyâª
I'm tearing up already~!!

Royce and Royce quickly masked
the tears on the verge of spilling over
with some quick self-promotion, and then—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, you see, if you just look at my record,
it might seem like I'm amazing.
But the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The exceptional one is my Trainer.
Super exceptional, even! People just don't know how remarkably capable they are.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I remember... At first, all I did was teach her
the ABCs of producing. But now—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, the tables turned...
But being the one getting wrapped around their finger
gradually started to make me happy...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ikuno? Isn't this kind of turning into...
a humblebrag about your love life?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. Her cheeks are slightly flushed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If I don't put the brakes on this soon, it's never gonna end. All right...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey Royce, if your Trainer is really that amazing,
won't you share some of that with me?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh, sharing some with me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yep! We were wondering if you could be our temporary Trainer for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I won't ask you to lend it to me for free.
Let's see—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How about a "Karaoke showdown"?
The Umamusume with the highest score
gets to rent it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A karaoke battle...
If I lose, everything will be taken away...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
Then I'll just have to~~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I-D-O-L!
We are idols, super idols♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Twinkling eyes for every TPOâ
Pyoong!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is this~... A complete copy...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It's a wonderful recreation. From the original pitch all the way down to the dance.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate my repertoire.
I research day and night so that I can
portray any kind of personality!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The raging waaaaaves of Suruuuuga!
A father's~~~ stubborn priiiiide!!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Be myself! Be my shout!
From ultra-high, here's our hos-pi-tal-i-ty!
Hey!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: N-No one could ever beat something like that~~~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true.
If it's not going to be much of a contest anyway, maybe I should just...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Royce-e!!
There you go, put your back into it!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's been changed to a solo live!
Go all out and have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature-san. Looks like you've given up.
In that case, I'm going all out!

And so, Royce and Royce adorned her great feat
with a colorful variety of songs and dances.
